lines.text: Hello friends, the moon is high,
Time for bed, let's sing goodnight!
Splash and splash in the warm bath,
Bubbles float up high, pop, pop, pop!
Brush, brush, brush our little teeth clean,
Up and down, and round and round.
Time for bed, sleepyhead,
Moon is glowing, stars are bright,
Snuggle down in your cozy bed,
Time for bed, sleepyhead, goodnight.
Did you know? Sleep helps your body grow big and strong.
One arm in, and two arms in,
Our pajamas are so soft and warm.
Pick a book and sit up close,
Turn the pages slow, one, two, three.
Time for bed, sleepyhead,
Moon is glowing, stars are bright,
Snuggle down in your cozy bed,
Time for bed, sleepyhead, goodnight.
Wave goodnight to the moon and stars,
Yawn so big and stretch up slow.
Big warm hug, a squeeze so tight,
Kiss goodnight and turn down the light.
Teddy is here, the night light glows,
Close your eyes now, nice and slow.
Time for bed, sleepyhead,
Moon is glowing, stars are bright,
Snuggle down in your cozy bed,
Time for bed, sleepyhead, goodnight.
Time for bed, sleepyhead,
Moon is glowing, stars are bright,
Snuggle down in your cozy bed,
Time for bed, sleepyhead, goodnight.
Sweet dreams, sleepyhead. Sing it again tomorrow night!
